thread:
ashley: kicking off canary for release v0.9.12 -> eu-west, 20% traffic. change window 10:00-11:00 UTC. watching embed-route p95 and 5xx closely. deploy-bot will post checkpoints.

deploy-bot: rollout started: v0.9.12 -> eu-west (canary 20%). jobs: smoke-tests, obs-checks. https://console.redwood.io/r/rollouts/1719998888

nina: saw a small p95 blip on embed-service ~30s after start, +120ms to 95th, baseline ~110ms -> 230ms. no 5xx yet. :eyes:

samir: can you grab the route-level p95 and error rate? ping the dashboard link?

mike: eyeballing the SLO dashboard — embed-route p95 jumped, and there's an uptick in backend latency from the KV cache host pool. quick query I ran: ```sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/embed"}[5m])) by (le)``` looks noisy around tail.

heidi_oncall: running smoke tests now (embed-lookup, partial prefix cache, auth). will post results in a sec.

nina: smoke passed for auth and basic payloads, but heavy payload(>8k tokens) requests show ~10% timeout-ish errors (504) in the canary slice. small sample though.

ashley: ok hold traffic at 20%. don't increase ramp. samir, can you check routing fallback to smaller-context model variant (v0.9.11-quant) as a mitigation? if it's a quantization perf regression we can fallback quickly.

samir: looking. routing policy currently points to model-group:embed-v0.9.12, fallback: embed-v0.9.11-quant is available in eu-west. I can add a temporary route override for canary only. want me to apply?

mike: before making changes, confirm whether KV cache GC ran recently on the hosts that saw latency. if GC + quantized kernel conflict, that explains heavy-payload timeouts. ops/infra telemetry?

heidi_oncall: agent-check: hostpool-embed-eu-3 had a GC at 09:57 UTC (5m before rollout). I'm seeing elevated GC pause p90 there. correlates with the early spike.

ashley: that matches. plan: 1) keep canary at 20% 2) add per-route override to route heavy-payload requests to 0.9.11-quant for 10m 3) run extended smoke on heavy payloads 4) if 5xx >1% or p95 >+150ms, rollback fully. agree? :thumbsup:

nina: +1, will keep sampling and send counts.

samir: applying route override for canary slice now: ```rbac apply-route-override --route /embed --env eu-west --from v0.9.12 --to v0.9.11-quant --duration 10m --target canary```

deploy-bot: route override applied (id: ro-1719998888-1). canary: heavy-payload -> embed-v0.9.11-quant. will auto-expire in 10m.

heidi_oncall: re-running heavy payload smoke now. initial 50 requests: 0 timeouts, p95 ~130ms. looks improved.

mike: dashboard looks cleaner for the override slice. overall canary p95 down to +40ms above baseline and no new 504s in the sample.

ashley: good. we'll monitor for the next 10m. if it stays healthy, proceed with slow ramp to 50% after approval. if it regresses we'll rollback to v0.9.11 cluster-wide and open a postmortem. I'll update release notes with the mitigation.

nina: logging observed counts: canary total requests 2.1k, heavy payloads 230 samples, 504s dropped from 10 -> 0 after override. attaching quick stats: `canary:2.1k, heavy:230, 504_before:10, 504_after:0`

samir: note for follow-up: investigate kernel selection interaction with recent quant kernels and GC schedule on embed hostpool. I'll file ENG-PLAT-5637.

deploy-bot: checkpoint: 5m elapsed, canary health nominal, override active, next auto-check in 5m.

ashley: thanks team. leave this thread pinned to the change window. tagging eng-sre to eyeball overnight if we continue ramp. :raised_hands:
